Twelve South is a company that makes a range of high-quality Apple accessories, and the company has now massively expanded its AirFly brand. Twelve South today (今日) launched AirFly Drive, an adapter that converts wired CarPlay into wireless CarPlay, and is taking pre-orders starting today for $39.99. Here's how it works.

According to Twelve South, AirFly Drive works in most cars that come with wired CarPlay from the factory, covering more than 75 brands, with model years going all the way back to 2014. AirFly Drive itself uses a USB-A connector, but Twelve South includes a USB-C adapter in the box. The product features a small aluminum design meant to be left plugged into the car at all times.

Twelve South's AirFly Drive requires no app or account. Users simply plug it into the USB port in the car and pair it with their phone once to complete setup. After that, AirFly Drive will automatically reconnect to the phone every time the user gets in the car, providing a wireless CarPlay experience. It also supports pairing two phones at the same time, and switching between them is as simple as pressing a button.

Twelve South lists some of the specs and features:

  • Wireless Apple CarPlay and Android Auto on your car's built-in display.
  • Plug and play, no apps, accounts, or charging required.
  • Fast automatic reconnection every time the car starts.
  • One button to switch between two paired phones.
  • Small aluminum housing designed to be left plugged in at all times.
  • Supports both USB-A and USB-C, with a USB-A to USB-C adapter included in the box.
  • Compatible with the car's existing display, buttons, and steering wheel controls.
  • Ongoing compatibility updates.

Wireless CarPlay is much smoother than wired CarPlay, and this is especially noticeable for short drives around town. This is a useful upgrade that improves the CarPlay experience.

AirFly Drive is available for order from the Twelve South website starting today for $39.99, with both black and white options. The product is also compatible with Android Auto.
